name: gizza-ai/parse-pcap
summary: Parse a pcap/pcapng capture into a per-packet summary.

tool.description: Parse an uploaded libpcap (.pcap) or pcapng (.pcapng) network capture into a per-packet summary. Decodes the link layer (Ethernet, with VLAN tags, plus raw-IP / Linux-cooked / loopback) and the network/transport layers: IPv4, IPv6, TCP (with flag names), UDP, ICMP/ICMPv6, and ARP. Each packet reports its capture timestamp, on-wire and captured length, source/destination addresses, source/destination ports (TCP/UDP), the highest decoded protocol, and a one-line description. Returns the container format, link type, total packet count, and the decoded packets (capped by limit). Provide the capture as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

limit.description: Maximum number of packets to decode and return (1-5000, default 200). The total packet count is always reported even when the list is truncated.
